City Council and Successor Agency Special Meeting
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
NOVEMBER 15, 2022
9:00
A.M.
11-15-22 Agenda
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Klinakis, Munoz, Argudo, Mendoza, and Quinones
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Employee Recognition Awards
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council/Successor Agency on an item other than a public hearing matter, complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. All speakers are requested to observe the City's Rules of Decorum when addressing the City Council. (LPMC section 2.04.120.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Boards/Commission/Committee meetings, listed below, that they have attended or that have occurred.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF SEPTEMBER 27, 2022 AND OCTOBER 11, 2022
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of September 27, 2022 and October 11, 2022.
A-1 Minutes 9-27-22 CC SA
A-1 Minutes 10-11-22 CC SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL – None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL – None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTERS NOS. 1540 AND 1541
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 22-5758 approving Warrant Register No. 1540 and Resolution No. 22-5759 approving Warrant Register No. 1541.
D-1 Warrant Register #1540
D-1 Warrant Register #1541
D-2
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER AND OCTOBER 2022 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORTS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the reports.
D-2 Sept Oct Requisition Summary Report Staff Report
D-2 Sept Oct Requisition Summary Report Attachments A-B Reports
D-3
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER AND OCTOBER 2022 INVESTMENT REPORTS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 Sep Oct Investment Report Staff Report
D-3 Sep Oct Investment Reports Attachments A-E
D-4
CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF A 30-DAY RESOLUTION REGARDING THE CONDUCT OF TELECONFERENCED MEETINGS OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND OTHER CITY BODIES UNDER THE MODIFIED RULES SET FORTH UNDER GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54953(E) AND OTHER APPLICABLE PROVISIONS AS AMENDED BY AB 361
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-5760, authorizing the City Council, City Boards, and all Commissions of the City continue to hold teleconferenced meetings from November 14, 2022, through December 14, 2022.
D-4 AB 361 Monthly Extension Staff Report
D-4 AB 361 Monthly Extension Attachment A Resolution
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH ADVANCED APPLIED ENGINEERING, INC. FOR ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR THE WEST RESTROOM AT LA PUENTE PARK IN THE AMOUNT OF $51,746.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Agreement with Advanced Applied Engineering, Inc. for architectural design and construction support services in the amount of $51,746.00; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-5 AAE Hacienda Restroom Staff Report
D-5 AAE Hacienda Restroom Attachment A Agreement
D-6
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION CHAPTER 3.68 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING PUBLIC PARKS AND FACILITIES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 22-979 Amending Chapter 3.68 of the La Puente City Municipal Code Regarding Public Parks and Facilities.
D-6 La Puente Park Rules Update Second Reading Staff Report
D-6 La Puente Park Rules Update Second Reading Attachment A Ordinance
D-7
CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF FINAL PARCEL MAP NO. 82347 AND SUBDIVISION IMPROVEMENT AGREEMENT FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 658 DEL VALLE AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) find that Final Parcel Map No. 82347 complies with all of the Conditions of Approval set forth within Tentative Parcel Map No. 82347; (2) approve the attached Subdivision Improvement Agreement and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City; and (3) approve the Final Map and authorize the City Clerk to endorse the cover sheet of the Final Map, the certificate which embodies the approval of said Map for recordation with the County of Los Angeles.
D-7 658 Del Valle TPM 82347 Staff Report
D-7 658 Del Valle TPM 82347 Attachment A Resolution
D-7 658 Del Valle TPM 82347 Attachment B Agreement
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH SUPERIOR SECURITY SPECIALISTS, INC. DBA SUPERIOR ALARM SYSTEMS FOR SECURITY CAMERAS AND SPEAKER SYSTEM AT LA PUENTE PARK IN THE AMOUNT OF $132,900.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 2 to the Agreement with Superior Security Specialists, Inc., dba Superior Alarm Systems in the amount of $132,900.00; (2) and authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment and approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount on behalf of the City.
D-8 SAS Park Security and Speakers Amend Staff Report
D-8 SAS Park Security and Speakers Amend Attachment A Amendment
D-9
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION DECLARING AS SURPLUS PROPERTY FOUR VEHICLES IN THE CITY’S FLEET, AUTHORIZING THE SALE OF THE SURPLUS VEHICLES BY ENTERPRISE FLEET MANAGEMENT FOR THE SALE OF THE VEHICLES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 22-5761 and declare as surplus property, four vehicles in the City’s fleet, authorizing the sale of the surplus vehicle at auction; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreements on behalf of the City.
D-9 Surplus Vehicles Staff Report
D-9 Surplus Vehicles Attachment A Resolution
D-10
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH EMERGENCY PLANNING CONSULTANTS FOR THE PREPARATION OF A HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN IN THE AMOUNT OF $50,000.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Agreement with Emergency Planning Consultants for preparation of a Hazard Mitigation Plan in the amount of $50,000.00; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City; and (3) approve Resolution No. 22-5762 amending the Fiscal Year 2022/23 Operating Budget.
D-10 Emergency Planning Consultants Hazard Mitigation Plan Staff Report
D-10 Emergency Planning Consultants Hazard Mitigation Plan Attachment A FEMA Letter
D-10 Emergency Planning Consultants Hazard Mitigation Plan Attachment B Agreement
D-10 Emergency Planning Consultants Hazard Mitigation Plan Attachment C Resolution
D-11
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT TO TOWO ENTERPRISE INC. FOR IMPROVEMENTS AT EIGHT CROSSWALK LOCATIONS, FEDERAL PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5331(021), IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,042,198
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to TOWO Enterprise Inc. in the amount of $1,042,198; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement and approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount; and (3) adopt Resolution No. 22-5763 amending the Fiscal Year 2022/23 Capital Budget.
D-11 TOWO HSIP Eight Crosswalks Award Staff Report
D-11 TOWO HSIP Eight Crosswalks Award Attachment A Agreement
D-11 TOWO HSIP Eight Crosswalks Award Attachment B Resolution
D-11 TOWO HSIP Eight Crosswalks Award Attachment C Leonida Letter
D-12
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT TO NPG CORPORATION FOR COMMUNITY CENTER PARKING LOT IMPROVEMENTS IN THE AMOUNT OF $200,989.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to NPG Corporation in the amount of $200,989.00; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement and approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount; and (3) adopt Resolution No. 22-5764.
D-12 NPG Community Center Parking Lot Award Staff Report
D-12 NPG Community Center Parking Lot Award Attachment A Resolution
D-12 NPG Community Center Parking Lot Award Attachment B Agreement
D-13
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AND LICENSE AGREEMENT WITH SEMPER ANTICUS FOR THE OPERATION AND MANAGEMENT OF AN OPEN-AIR MARKET
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Professional Services and License Agreement with Semper Anticus; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment on behalf of the City.
D-13 Semper Anticus LP Live Staff Report
D-13 Sember Anticus LP Live Attachment A Agreement
D-14
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF A PURCHASE ORDER CONTRACT WITH ANTROPY INC. FOR THE PURCHASE OF REPLACEMENT FORTINET SWITCHES & NETWORK SECURITY DEVICES.
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve a purchase order contract in the amount of $71.426.06 with Antropy, Inc. for the purchase of all new Fortinet hardware plus the additional $7,500 to properly setup and install the devices for a total of $78,926.06; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute, on behalf of the City, all documents necessary to effectuate this action.
D-14 Antropy Hardware Replacement Staff Report
D-14 Antropy Hardware Replacement Attachment A Bid
D-14 Antropy Hardware Replacement Attachment B Bid Sheet
D-15
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A MASTER AGREEMENT AND PROGRAM SUPPLEMENT AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA FOR FEDERAL AID PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5331(021) FOR CONSTRUCTION OF PEDESTRIAN SAFETY IMPROVEMENTS AT EIGHT CROSSWALK LOCATIONS
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) Adopt Resolution No. 22-5765 approving Master Agreement No. 07-5331F15 and Program Supplement Agreement No. F014 for construction of Pedestrian Safety Improvements at Eight Crosswalk Locations; and (2) authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute the Master Agreement and Program Supplement Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-15 State Grant HSIP Eight Crosswalks Staff Report
D-15 State Grant HSIP Eight Crosswalks Attachment A Master Agreement
D-15 State Grant HSIP Eight Crosswalks Attachment B Program Supplement Agreement
D-15 State Grant HSIP Eight Crosswalks Attachment C Resolution
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER AND OCTOBER 2022 BUDGET REPORTS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
E-1 Sept Oct Budget Report Staff Report
E-1 Sep Oct Budget Report Attachments A-B Reports
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF YOUTH WORKFORCE GRANT SUBRECIPIENT AGREEMENTS TO DELHAVEN COMMUNITY CENTER, GOODWILL SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA, AND SAN GABRIEL VALLEY CONSERVATION CORPS.
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award subrecipient agreements to Delhaven Community Center, Goodwill Southern California, and San Gabriel Valley Conservation Corps; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute all documents necessary to effectuate these agreements.
E-2 Youth Workforce Grant Staff Report
E-2 Youth Workforce Grant Attachment A Delhaven Agreement
E-2 Youth Workforce Grant Attachment B Goodwill Agreement

DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE MELLOW MAN ACE EDUTAINMENT ARTS PROGRAM (COMMUNITY SAFETY AND WELFARE AD HOC COMMITTEE)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss this item and provide any necessary direction to Staff.

ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this 10th day of November 2022
